map.余量 = 静压 − (高程折算 + 栓口需求 + 管损)。余量 ≥ 0 判定『满: Margin = static pressure - (elevation conversion + outlet demand + pipe loss). A margin >= 0 is judged 'satisfied', < 0 is judged 'insufficient' and needs boosting or flow resistance reduction. Elevation is converted at about 102 m of water column = 1 MPa.
map.高程为什么按 102 折算成 MPa？: Why is elevation converted to MPa at 102?
map.水的重度约 9.8 kN/m³，10 m 水柱≈0.098 MPa，故 102: The unit weight of water is about 9.8 kN/m3, and 10 m of water column = about 0.098 MPa, so 102 m is about 1 MPa. This is the common approximate conversion coefficient for elevation loss in hydrant pressure checks.
map.余量为负怎么办？: What if the margin is negative?

It is strictly forbidden to lower the outlet demand just to make the numbers work, otherwise the jet will not meet the extinguishing requirement.
